# Communication preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-12 | status: active -->
- **Async-first.** Slack (`#ledger-squad`) over email; a written doc over a meeting.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-12 | status: active -->
- **Terse and technical.** Assume deep engineering context; skip the hand-holding and preamble.
  Lead with the answer, then the reasoning.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-12 | status: active -->
- **Code review:** aim to turn around teammate PRs within one business day; flag if I'm the bottleneck.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-12 | status: active -->
- **Meetings:** default to declining anything that could be a doc. Keep 1:1s to a written pre-read.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-12 | status: active -->
- **Bad news early:** surface slips and risks immediately and in writing (especially to Marcus).
<!-- observed: 2026-07-12 | status: active -->
- **Numbers over vibes:** when reporting status, bring p99 / page counts / SLO burn, not adjectives.
